Sidebar (Admin): the app entry 'Expense Calculator' lists exactly two children, 'Expense rules' and 'History' (no 'Calculator' child); the app name opens /app/calculator; 'Expense rules' highlights on /app/rules; History highlights on /app/history and /app/history/:id.

Header actions in the Admin title bar work: Calculator -> Calculate (validates, then goes to Results) and Edit rules; Rules -> Reset to placeholder defaults (opens the confirm modal; 'Replace values' fills the form); Results -> Save calculation (opens the save modal; Save creates the snapshot and lands on History detail with the 'Calculation saved' toast) and Change revenue; History -> New calculation; History detail -> Duplicate as new calculation.

Rules page save bar: editing any switch / rule type / value shows the App Bridge save bar; Discard restores the saved values and clears any error banner; Save persists and shows the 'Rule changes saved' toast with a Calculate action that opens the Calculator; 'Reset to placeholder defaults' makes the save bar appear (a synthetic input/change event is dispatched on the form) and Discard undoes it; navigating away with unsaved edits raises the Leave-page prompt.

After saving rules, the Calculator's read-only summary shows the saved values and Calculate/Results use them (e.g. Shipping 777.25 appears in the Results row and total); a saved-OFF category is absent from Results.

Calculator: the currency select shows 'USD - US Dollar' immediately on first open and after Change revenue / Duplicate (no blank flash); typing -5, 1,5, 10.555, 1e5 shows the exact message live; Enter in the revenue field calculates.

Results: metric tiles are three columns at a normal Admin width; the breakdown table and donut sit side by side; the header shows the breadcrumb 'Calculator'. History detail: the header shows the breadcrumb 'History' and the Duplicate action; the snapshot banner, lock badge and engine version are visible.
